name: web-clean-hoodie-product-page-with-thumbnails-and-swatches
title: Minimal hoodie PDP with vertical thumbnails, colour and size selectors, tabs and related grid
whatItIs: A white page with a top shipping bar, centred logo nav, vertical thumbnail strip with a large model photo, product title, rating, price with discount tag, colour swatches, size pills, a wide black Add to Cart with heart, trust icons, detail tabs with a macro fabric photo and a 'You may also like' row.
whatItMeans: Clear and trustworthy; consistent controls and neutral styling suit a clothing store.
techniques: Use a vertical thumbnail strip beside a large photo.
Show a macro fabric photo for quality.

vocabulary.definition: A vertical column of small product images.
A circle showing a colour option.
Small icons for shipping and returns.
